diagnostic: Independent native-plan review did not approve: {'approved': False, 'reason': "REJECT - the plan does not actually exercise the repository's native e2e coverage. All cited hashes verify (plan_sha256 is sha256 of the sorted/minified `plan` object; all 14 sources match). Traceable native commands: `npm run lint` (scripts.check-vercel-routes.mjs && oxlint), `npm run build` (vite build && node scripts/ota-bundle.mjs), `npm run e2e`, `npm run e2e:guard` (package.json), `test:security` (node tests/run.js), `test:migration`, `test:staging` (server/package.json); .github/workflows/ci.yml runs lint/build/test:security/test:migration/test:staging and .github/workflows/e2e-local.yml runs e2e:guard/e2e. Coverage list matches those jobs, and there is NO native format check (no format script in either package.json or either workflow), so empty format_checks is correct. HOWEVER the e2e step cannot run: bootstrap starts a single postgres:17 container at 127.0.0.1:5432 with POSTGRES_DB=buildcity_test, whereas final_tests `npm run e2e` -> scripts/e2e-local.mjs sets dbUrl = process.env.DATABASE_URL || DEFAULT_DB and DEFAULT_DB = postgresql://postgres:DUMMYPASS@127.0.0.1:5436/buildcity_e2e (port 5436, db buildcity_e2e). The step sets no DATABASE_URL and nothing provisions 5436/buildcity_e2e, so scripts/e2e-local.mjs:96 dies with 'e2e refused: cannot reach the database (is it running?)' before any prisma db push/seed/API/vite/Playwright work. If DATABASE_URL were instead inherited as the plan's 5432/buildcity_test, e2e-local still refuses because the earlier `test:security` (server/tests/run.js runs `prisma db push`) leaves buildcity_test an unmarked DB that already has tables -> 'the database is unmarked but already has tables; refusing to claim it as a test database'. Either way the native e2e job (e2e/specs/*) executes 0 tests. Additionally both `npm run e2e:guard` steps set no DATABASE_URL, so the loopback guard test 'e2e-local refuses an unmarked database that already has tables' (e2e/guard.test.mjs:144) takes the t.skip('no DATABASE_URL') path, whereas native e2e-local.yml sets DATABASE_URL job-wide so it runs. Minor: test:staging's refresh-dryrun.sh needs host psql (refresh-dryrun.sh:179, native ci.yml installs postgresql-client; present on this host); and `VERCEL=1 VERCEL_ENV=preview npx vite build --outDir dist-preview-check` is not a native build target.
